summary: Modern three-bedroom semi-detached home on the popular Oaks development, featuring gardens, parking and no onward chain. Conveniently located for Carlisle, the M6 and south-west Scotland.
description:
Situated within the modern and sought-after development of The Oaks, and conveniently positioned close to a popular Borders market town, this attractive three-bedroom semi-detached home offers spacious, well-presented accommodation and is available with no onward chain.

The accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall, a convenient cloakroom/WC, a bright and comfortable living room, and a generous dining kitchen ideal for modern family living. To the first floor are three well-proportioned bedrooms and a family bathroom.

Externally, the property benefits from gardens to both the front and rear, together with off-street parking.

The location is particularly well suited to commuters, with excellent access to Carlisle and south-west Scotland. The M6 motorway is approximately 5 to 10 minutes away by car, while Carlisle city centre can be reached in around 15 minutes, providing a wide range of shopping, leisure and transport facilities

Directions From Carlisle follow the A7 to reach Longtown. In the centre take the right turn after the traffic lights onto Netherby Street which becomes Graham Street. Sycamore Drive is the first right.

Services Mains electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
